content: Moreover, GlossBERT(Token-CLS) performs better than GlossBERT(Sent-CLS), which proves that highlighting the target word in the sentence is important. However, the weakly highlighting method GlossBERT(Sent-CLS-WS) performs best in most circumstances, which may result from its combination of the advantages of the other two methods.
